gaps.title: P1 downstream experiment/evaluation/finding binding
gaps.recommended_frontier: RVO-only downstream P1 binding, synthetic-first, after RVO-04 human routing decision.

gaps.title: SMF result/procedure binding beyond activation
gaps.recommended_frontier: RVO-only binding to exact qualified SMF CORE outputs, synthetic-first.

gaps.title: Claim-scoped data identity/admissibility/provenance qualification
gaps.decision: A universal generic Data abstraction is not required before first use. The exact dataset family/schema consumed by the first real empirical claim must be qualified. If the first claim uses H1/derived data, the current tick-CSV boundary is insufficient.
minimum_maturation: handoff interface to Temporal for time-validity semantics
gaps.recommended_frontier: DATA-01 — CLAIM-SCOPED DATA ADMISSIBILITY + PROVENANCE QUALIFICATION

gaps.title: Minimal point-in-time admissibility owner
minimum_maturation: no execution-time retroactive expansion of historical information
not_required_before: pure retrospective CC02 description that makes no historical-availability/tradability claim
gaps.recommended_frontier: TEMPORAL-01 — MINIMAL POINT-IN-TIME ADMISSIBILITY CONTRACT + TEST-FIRST QUALIFICATION

gaps.title: Generic claim-sufficient execution/cost owner
minimum_maturation: forbidden claim set when cost/realism surface is incomplete
gaps.note: E1-04 may be reused only for an exact E1-scoped claim inside its qualified limits; it must not be generalized by RVO.

gaps.title: Real forward provenance persistence activation
gaps.recommended_frontier: Only reopen the separately governed MCEPR forward-persistence activation when a selected claim actually requires durable cross-experiment provenance.

gaps.title: Conditional C01-C12 implementation
gaps.decision: Do not implement C01-C12 as a catalogue. Open only the exact family whose activation condition is present in the selected claim.
gaps.recommended_frontier: SMF-Cxx owner-specific frontier only after claim activation identifies the exact required conditional family.

gaps.title: Real experiment / OOS consumption authority
blocks: CC10_OOS_CONFIRMATION requires separate OOS consumption authority
gaps.recommended_frontier: Separate human authorization only after capability readiness is demonstrated; capability PASS never self-grants this authority.

FIRST_REAL_PROTOCOL_ONLY: Close GAP-RVO04-01 only if downstream P1 finding is required by the selected protocol claim.
No Data/Temporal/Execution owner maturation is required for a pure protocol claim.
Separate real-use human authorization remains mandatory.
FIRST_REAL_EMPIRICAL_DESCRIPTIVE: SMF M03 binding if empirical distribution/quantile claim is made
Temporal only if historical availability/tradability is asserted
FIRST_REAL_PREDICTIVE: GAP-RVO04-06 MCEPR activation if search provenance is material
GAP-RVO04-07 only for conditionally activated methods such as C11
FIRST_REAL_PATH_RISK: GAP-RVO04-07 C09 and/or C10 as required
GAP-RVO04-04 TEMPORAL when historical calibration is used

global_recommendation.rationale: Data is the broadest common owner prerequisite for every meaningful empirical market claim while remaining unnecessary for pure protocol-only claims. Qualify the exact first-use data family rather than constructing a universal Data layer.
global_recommendation.second_owner_frontier: GAP-RVO04-04 / TEMPORAL-01 if the selected first empirical claim is predictive, historical, OOS, or economic.
global_recommendation.third_owner_frontier: GAP-RVO04-05 / EXECUTION-01 only when a net-economic or path-policy claim is actually selected.
global_recommendation.conditional_frontiers: SMF C01-C12 and MCEPR real persistence only when claim activation makes them material.
